name.zh: 年少黑乃在模拟战中击败宁音
name.en: Young Kurono defeats Nene in a mock duel

periods.summary: After Nene's arrest following underground-arena violence, Nango offers to sponsor her at Bukyoku Academy and provokes her with the claim that a girl her age is stronger. He arranges a mock battle at Hagun against young Kurono Takizawa. Kurono's time powers overwhelm Nene: Clock Up evades her, Clock Lock stops her in place, Clock Draw arranges unavoidable bullet patterns, and Climax Moment breaks her repeatedly. Nene nevertheless refuses to fall, uses spatial bending and finally bites off part of her tongue to fake real injury and draw Kurono close. She scores one knockdown and enrages Kurono, but Kurono retaliates mercilessly and wins. Afterward Nango explains that chasing a maddening, seemingly unreachable rival is what made the fight enjoyable, and Nene accepts the goal of surpassing Kurono.
periods.cause: Nango wants to redirect Nene's destructive talent by giving her an impossible rival rather than prison, exile or empty underground violence.
periods.outcome: Nene loses for the first time, enters Bukyoku under Nango, and dedicates herself to defeating Kurono; Kurono becomes both Nene's envy and ideal.
periods.significance: Defines Nene's entire later identity: Kurono is the one opponent who makes her angry, joyful and ambitious enough to remain human and grow.
